sn35.59:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– kathannu kho bhante jānato kathaṃ passato
sn35.59:1.3: cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu, anattato jānato passato anusayā samugghātaṃ gacchanti, rūpe …pe…
sn35.59:1.12: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattato jānato passato anusayā samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
sn35.59:1.13: evaṃ kho bhikkhu, jānato evaṃ passato anusayā samugghātaṃ gacchantī
